q: What share of our customers have ordered more than once, and are new customers or repeat customers worth more?
answer:
About 25.6% of customers this month have ordered more than once, slightly up from 25.1% last month. New customers and repeat customers are worth about the same, with a lifetime value of ₹1,793 each this month, up from ₹1,621 last month.

- New customers contributed ₹12,44,291 in net sales this month, while repeat customers added ₹5,10,199.
- Repeat customers make up 25.6% of the customer base but account for 29% of net sales, showing their importance for revenue.

Period: 2026-10-01–2026-10-28 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-28
